summary: A mixed legal and retail day, dominated by regulatory moves in e-commerce and infrastructure, alongside strong festive demand signals and a major Reliance bond issuance.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court grants bail to UAPA accused held in custody for 8 years without trial completion.
India tightens e-commerce rules with new consumer safeguards; specific requirements not detailed in available text.
Amazon's quick commerce business crosses $1 billion in gross annualised sales in India.
India's festive demand hits 5-year high; consumer spending surge recorded across appliances, automobiles, apparel, quick commerce.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion in 5-year rupee bond sale; first domestic rupee bond since 2023.
